milestones.title: 1 · Language and lossless syntax
milestones.description: Progressive four-tier DSL, immutable lossless syntax, scoped relational scenegraph and diagnostics.

milestones.title: 2 · Bidirectional authoring
milestones.description: Typed atomic edits, minimal UTF-8 splices, semantic gesture synthesis and undo/redo.

milestones.title: 3 · Stable orthogonal layout
milestones.description: Port constraints, compound geometry, incremental stability, visibility routing and parallel lanes.

milestones.title: 4 · Labels, rendering and delivery
milestones.description: Collision-free labels, continuous polish, SVG, CLI, Wasm, documentation and measured performance.

milestones.title: 5 · Ecosystem and cognitive notation
milestones.description: RFC-001 sections 4 and 8: views, semantic zoom, editorial rendering, export, editor integrations, linter and MCP.

milestones.title: 6 · Executable and epistemic extensions
milestones.description: RFC-001 section 7: simulation, observed drift, formal traces, strata, lenses, attention and Spatial Git.

issues.title: Bootstrap Rust crate, CI and specification fixtures
issues.acceptance: Provide a documented public Rust API, reproducible dependency lockfile, CI formatting/lint/test checks, and fixtures from both uploaded specifications.

issues.title: Implement progressive DSL and lossless red-green CST
issues.acceptance: Parse nodes, containers, all edge operators/chains, five port tiers, zones, align/distribute, flows and layout annotations. Preserve every byte including CRLF, Unicode, comments and malformed input. Expose typed syntax wrappers, origins and incremental reparsing.

issues.title: Lower scoped relational scenegraph with source origins
issues.acceptance: Resolve qualified and lexical references, inferred nodes, explicit ports and shapes. Represent zones as shared references rather than parents; retain flow steps, layout variants, attributes, source origins and actionable diagnostics.

issues.title: Implement atomic source-preserving structured edits
issues.acceptance: Support pin/size locks, alignment, port constraints, route channels, label slides and unpin. Patch only affected tokens; preserve trivia; reject overlapping or stale UTF-8 patches atomically.

issues.title: Synthesize semantic gestures and relax conflicting alignments
issues.acceptance: Promote peer snaps within 6px, container-relative pins within 6g, quantized 16px fallback, three-node layout-block placement and 24px breakaway alignment pruning in a single transaction.

issues.title: Add immutable document snapshots and undo/redo
issues.acceptance: Maintain synchronized syntax/IR/layout snapshots with versioned transactions, safe incremental reparsing and undo/redo restoring exact bytes.

issues.title: Assign five-tier ports and deterministic topology
issues.acceptance: Honor free, side, clockwise order, ratio and exact slot constraints, outward stubs and corner/port clearance. Resize high-fanout nodes; use deterministic barycentric ordering and bounded cyclic shape optimization.

issues.title: Implement separable VPSC and recursive containers
issues.acceptance: Solve weighted coordinate projection with separation/equality constraints, hard non-overlap and containment, pins, relative anchors, align/distribute and port straightening; diagnose infeasible geometry.

issues.title: Preserve mental map across incremental layouts
issues.acceptance: Implement translation-adjusted anchors, degree weights, elastic relative ordering, Delaunay proximity and source-order tie breaks. Expose metrics and accept prior layout state.

issues.title: Route obstacle-avoiding orthogonal connectors
issues.acceptance: Build visibility graph from padded obstacles and mandatory port stubs. Use direction-aware A* with length, bend, backward, crossing and overlap costs; handle self-loops, cycles and compound boundaries.

issues.title: Separate shared-channel connector tracks
issues.acceptance: Deterministically order left/straight/right channel entries, assign spaced centered lanes within obstacle clearance and reroute affected edges incrementally.

issues.title: Place collision-free labels with discrete optimization
issues.acceptance: Generate port and edge candidates with cartographic priors, spatially index conflicts, solve conflict components with bounded exact selection and feasible pill/callout fallbacks; forbid node/port/label collisions.

issues.title: Polish label slides and channels with smooth distances
issues.acceptance: Provide rectangle SDF, stable softplus, forward derivatives and bounded L-BFGS polish over safe label slides/channel intervals; preserve hard geometry and expose calibrated objective weights.

issues.title: Render SVG with zones, ports, semantic flows and safe labels
issues.acceptance: Export deterministic escaped accessible SVG with compound containers, shapes, padded contours, numbered flow badges, port anchors, styled arrows and label knockout halos; include runnable examples and CLI.

issues.title: Deliver Wasm API, benchmarks and end-to-end validation
issues.acceptance: Expose text-to-diagram and edit APIs to Wasm, document supported syntax/algorithms/limits, run release benchmarks against the stated sub-16ms/sub-ms targets, and validate full specification fixtures and adversarial geometry.

issues.title: Implement canonical views, semantic zoom and composable lenses
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §§4, 7.5: project named views from one canonical graph; provide C1 continuous zoom and intersecting semantic lens membership with non-overlap fisheye layout.

issues.title: Add cognitive notation defaults, attention cones and story saliency
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §§4, 7.6: infer distinct silhouettes, provide OKLCH tonal hierarchy, crossing bridges, causal k-hop hover emphasis and @story-guided static saliency.

issues.title: Ship SVG/PDF/PNG exporter and editor previews
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §8 milestone 3: static SVG/PDF/PNG CLI export, VS Code and Neovim live previews with diagnostics and source-safe edits.

issues.title: Expose aesthetic linter and grammar-constrained MCP server
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §§4, 8: heuristic and pluggable VLM critique, structured actionable findings and an MCP interface for lossless edit transactions.

issues.title: Integrate fluid queueing simulation and counterfactual controls
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §7.1: @sim traits, coupled queue ODEs at 60Hz, ingress load, capacity/workers, timeout retries, severed edges, saturation, drops and browser-worker integration.

issues.title: Reconcile telemetry and code bindings as Phantom Drift
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §7.2: @bind symbol and OTel bindings, static symbol/observed-edge hydration, declared-vs-observed differential, pinned-node stability and promotion/CI violation actions.

issues.title: Verify bounded safety invariants and choreograph counterexamples
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §7.3: state variables, assertions and bounded SAT/SMT checking up to k=12; emit exact transition traces suitable for animated flow playback.

issues.title: Project independently laid out strata into oblique 2.5D
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §7.4: strata declarations, independent VPSC/A* planes, undistorted flat typography at theta=0, shear projection through pi/4, cross-layer via geometry and interactive rendering example.

issues.title: Implement bitemporal Spatial Git union layout and branch morph
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §7.7: stable entity matching, union compaction, locked unchanged infrastructure, amber removals/emerald additions, tau interpolation of geometry and simulation metrics, and PR diff viewer.

issues.title: Meet Wasm size and hierarchical incremental scaling budgets
issues.acceptance: RFC-001 §8: measure <450KB Brotli core Wasm, lazy extension loading, memoized container-level invalidation, >500-node local edits under 4ms; retain original latency and exact-solver requirements.
